name: Downscale Image
description: Downscales images in the input directory by a specified factor.

inputs.name: Input Directory
inputs.description: Directory containing images to downscale (PNG, JPG, TIFF, BMP, GIF, WEBP).

inputs.name: Scale Factor
inputs.description: Factor by which to downscale images (e.g., 2.0 for 1/2x downscale).

outputs.name: Output Directory
outputs.description: Directory where downscaled images will be saved.
